info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Test Subscriptions Management API
info.description: The Test Subscriptions Management API facilitates the validation of notification subscriptions by allowing users to test webhook configurations. This endpoint enables developers to verify that their webhook implementations are functioning correctly and can receive notifications as intended. Typical consumers of this API include developers and system integrators who need to ensure their integrations are reliable and responsive. By using this API, users can streamline their testing processes and ensure high-quality service interactions.

get.summary: Retrieve test subscriptions for a specific webhook resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of test subscriptions associated with the specified webhook resource. It provides essential information to help you manage and verify your webhook configurations effectively.
